title: Flip one proof byte of the genuine parent
verdictRule: Reject means verifies=false with exit 0, or a typed decoder refusal with exit 1; exit 0 alone is not the oracle (source45 README).

target.artifact: Sherlock A102->A80 k20 parent proof (6,432 bytes)

mutation.description: proof byte 0 XOR 1; everything else unchanged

seed.note: Source45 selected negative case 'proof_byte' (stdlib public verifier refusal, typed false, exit 0).

rationale: A well-formed but invalid proof must not be reported final-valid (ZR08/ZR16: tampered statement/proof/key rejects).
